name: Language Detective
source:
While on a space station orbiting an alien civilization, Dr. Linn, the team's Linguist has been murdered! As the detective, it's your job to solve the case!

Who could the killer be? Is it the Captain? the Chef? the Botanist? or Dr. Linn's daughter?

[From [url=https://teammelodies.itch.io/language-detective]itch.io[/url]]
